name: Ichijou Aki
source: Best friend of Hakuhouin Hikaru. Ichijou was the protagonist first rape victim. She wanted to remaind loyal to her boyfriend until the protagonist revealed that he found out that her boyfriend was sleeping with her mother. This cause her to fall in love for the protagonist. Even after Hikaru left the protagonist she continued to love the protagonist even willing to betray Hikaru to follow in his plans.
